newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Hotel and commerce stocks push Mauritius index up.
newsitem.headline: Hotel and commerce stocks push Mauritius index up.

text.p: Hotel-based Sun Resorts and conglomerate Rogers pushed up the SEMDEX market index at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius on Wednesday, bourse officials said.
Semdex gained 1.49 points to 385.52 on volume of 17.98 million rupees on 1,005,353 shares from 10.89 million rupees on 608,563 shares on Monday.

Sun Resorts was 50 cents higher at 49.00 rupees on 34,133 shares, New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 35.50 on 19,497 shares and leisure-based Automatic System rose 50 cents to 34.00 rupees on 10,000 shares.
Most stocks gained ground in the commerce sector.

Conglomerates Rogers climbed two rupees to 107.00 rupees on 3,150 shares and Ireland Blyth rose 10 cents to 15.10 rupees on 2,510 shares. Shell gained 40 cents on 600 shares and Happy World Foods was 60 cents up to 15.80 on 1,030 shares.
In the banking sector, State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 13 rupees on 805,300 shares and Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) was stable at 87.00 rupees on 23,035 shares.

In the investment sector, Fincorp was 50 cents higher at 70.50 rupees on 3,710 shares, Promotion And Development remained at 15.00 rupees on 4,958 shares and Policy was stable at 4.45 rupees on 24,920 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged to 39.00 rupees on 3,740 shares.
